messages:
Marta: Flag - partial FRA hold on H100 shipment (PO RWI-2026-11). Need quick call: clear via docs or air-replace + loaners?
Liam: Cause of hold? missing end-use or HS mismatch?
Sofie (TransLog): Customs flagged 3/8 units for end-use cert + HS recheck. Options: submit certs (~48-72h) or air-replace from NL pool (~24-48h) with premium fees.
Jordan: Rough cost for air-replace for 3 units?
Sofie (TransLog): ~EUR 7k per AWB for the 3-unit parcel (includes priority handling). Loaner fee (2 units) from NL ~EUR 2.5k for 14 days.
ops-bot: ALERT: eu-inference-pool H100 capacity -30%. Recommend routing non-critical traffic to us-east.
Liam: Redirecting will add ~40ms median. Can we mix: loan 2, air 1, clear 2 via docs?
Marta: Approve up to EUR 11k contingency for mixed plan. Proceed with loaner 2 + air 1.
Sofie (TransLog): Will start loaner paperwork and book AWB for 1 unit. ETA loaners 24-36h, AWB 36-48h excl. customs. Need serials for manifest + RMA tag.
Jordan: Serial list from manifest: SERN-AX11-101, SERN-AX11-102, SERN-AX11-103, SERN-AX11-104
Pat: Uploaded provisional proforma (HS 8542.31.90) and vendor VAT (NL987654321B02) to customs portal.
Ken (Customs): If proforma includes "temporary replacement - return within 30 days" we can attempt brokerage fast-track once docs are in.
Marta: Good. Ops will watch capacity and we will reconcile costs to the PO. Thanks - keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
